s01076.summary: In an empty ballroom Marguerite tells Thaddeus he is being promoted, not fired
Marguerite pitches a budgetless Innovation Pod and a ridiculous title to Thaddeus
Thaddeus calls out her cuts and the Farewell Sync invite for his mentor's funeral
Thaddeus unburdens his guilt over training staff who are being laid off
Thaddeus quits, slapping his name tag on the table despite her warning

s01044.summary: Orrin and Sable creep into the moth-covered library, bickering quietly
Tamsin nearly collides with them and insists they should not be here
The moths rise, Orrin draws his sword, and all three tumble together
Masked Vesper appears, calms the moths, and orders the lantern put down

s00015.summary: Around an empty coat, Hetty asks who last saw Doctor Marrow
Mei-Ling presses Soli about the keys and Bastian contradicts her account
Hetty questions Bastian's alibi while Pratt needles him about the plates
Mei-Ling catches Pratt lying about not visiting the observatory in years
Hetty establishes that Pratt has a key, narrowing it to four keyholders
Mei-Ling inches toward the coat while Pratt rambles to deflect suspicion
Bastian points out Pratt's wet cane and Hetty demands where Marrow is

s01084.summary: Rhee and Osei examine the body site in the drained pool
Rhee lifts the tarp and finds a single red high-heeled shoe
Captain Voss calls to say a janitor witness is coming down
Dolores Amadi descends into the pool, mop in hand
Dolores describes a tall quiet man in a long gray coat
Dolores produces the second red shoe from her apron pocket
A clang draws them to a silhouette atop the diving board
The figure leaps and collides with Rhee and Dolores in a tangle
The man scrambles up the stairs and escapes as Rhee vows pursuit
Shaken, Dolores tells Rhee she thinks she knows that coat

s01040.summary: Ilsa tends tomato vines in a greenhouse between day and night
Bram reports the heat sink rising and Ilsa snaps at him
Quillon rushes in to report the shade array jammed by a bolt
Sephora calls for help with a patient as everyone talks over each other
Sephora reveals the heat stroke patient is Ilsa's daughter
Ilsa orders the tomatoes saved and the array fixed, then runs off
Quillon drags Bram into action before the glass starts cracking

s01082.summary: Barnaby rehearses his pirate welcome speech to an empty clubhouse
Odalys teases Barnaby about the empty room and the looping parrot
A noisy family of six arrives and Barnaby greets them grandly
Odalys undercuts Barnaby's pitch to the family with deadpan honesty
Barnaby's bow sends his hat to a child, who wears it
Barnaby and Odalys hand out putters and scorecards as the parrot squawks

s01111.summary: Five friends hide in the dark awaiting the birthday girl
Keys scrape at the lock repeatedly while everyone freezes
The door opens on a stranger holding a pizza box
Lights flip, everyone yells surprise, and cake and pizza go flying
In frosting-dripping silence they realize he has the wrong apartment
Tibby licks frosting and offers to take the pizza

s01046.summary: Prudence stands outside a nap pod, waiting a long time
Malcolm emerges, unsurprised, and hands Prudence the coat she claims she came for
Malcolm breezily assures her the numbers will be fine
Prudence reveals she knows he rewrote her spreadsheet
Malcolm frames the rewrite as efficiency and streamlining
Prudence decides to stay in her office instead of going home
Prudence asks if he dreams, leaves, and Malcolm seals himself back in

s01086.summary: The alley waits as Annika needs ten pins for the title
Annika throws her first ball and leaves one pin standing
Hank gloats, Deshawn bristles, and Muriel holds him back
Over the shaky PA, Muriel steadies Annika for the final ball
Annika steps up again and gently rolls the ball into the last pin
The pin falls and the team erupts in celebration
Hank offers a sporting handshake and a ribbing rematch promise

pd_earnest_4.summary: Cecily and Gwendolen trade insults over Ernest's engagement
Merriman enters to lay tea, forcing the rivals into restraint
Under polite small talk, the women swap barbs about country and town
Cecily serves Gwendolen sugar and cake against her stated wishes
Gwendolen discovers the sabotage and warns Cecily she may go too far
Both rise and openly declare distrust and hostility
Jack enters and Gwendolen greets him as her own Ernest

s01072.summary: Renata contentedly eats lunch in her secret crawlspace above the office
The intercom announces a synergy audit as Renata calmly pours tea
Renata hears her eleven-month absence named and stares at her empty cubicle
A flashlight beam sweeps the crawlspace behind her

s01070.summary: In a flooded mill, a stranger wades toward the soldiers with hands up
Okafor demands his name and Teodor claims the mill is his brother's
Halvorsen notes he came from the enemy bank; Teodor says he swam
Engines approach, Okafor kills the lantern, and the radio gives only static

s01097.summary: The curling team sits in the bar after losing the final
Toby blames Rags for calling the hammer late
Rags slams her glass and insists the ice told her when
After a silence, Rags softens and says they did well
Toby jokes about sucking up with respect and Rags almost smiles
They toast the ninth end as the Zamboni erases the ice

s01062.summary: Two strangers wait on a stranded bus whose driver vanished long ago
Emery hears tapping; Naomi insists it is just the cold
Patient tapping sounds from the back of the bus
Emery decides to check the luggage rack despite Naomi's protest
Both stand, hesitate, and call out to the intruder in unison
A wet noise sounds and the duffel unzips itself
They back to the locked emergency door as pale fingers emerge
Emery pulls the lever and Naomi shoves them both out
They crawl away without looking back as a hand taps the glass

s01029.summary: Darryl types frantically and smiles while narrating his reorg despair
At a chime, Darryl clutches a stapler and recites corporate jargon
Darryl cheers the silent office and sips from an empty mug

s01045.summary: Leonard complains a goat is eating his sock during class
Mama Rose calls on speaker and needles Claudette and Leonard
Mama Rose demands she come home to fix a leaking faucet
Claudette gently brushes her mother off as the goat bleats
Claudette resettles and Leonard quips about paying for this

s01032.summary: Henrik sets Jethro and Pilar's grips for an arm-wrestling match
The match begins and neither moves as the crowd chants
Pilar needles Jethro about sweat and his mother's apron
Jethro surges an inch and Pilar drives back to even
Locked still, they share about her father and Matanzas
Jethro lunges, the table skids, and they tumble wrestling onto the sacks
Hands hovering over sugar, Pilar offers a truce and Henrik calls a draw
Panting on the sacks, they joke about a rematch and her dead father
Pilar smiles and slams her elbow down for another round

s01115.summary: In the treehouse, Augustine teases Winnie about cheating at cards
A thrown card falls and Lotte shyly offers licorice to everyone
The kids learn Lotte's name and that she moved from Rotterdam
The four sit in quiet music until a card lands in Lotte's lap

s00017.summary: Gloria bellows a welcome from the balloon to no one below
Winnie closes her eyes and tells herself not to look down
Gloria squints at a dial and mutters about something wrong
Gloria dodges Winnie's question with a call to smile for a nonexistent camera
Gloria hands Winnie the clipboard and tells her not to let go of the burner

pd_earnest_0.summary: Algernon boasts about his expressive piano playing to Lane
Lane smoothly explains away the missing champagne with remarks on marriage
Algernon dismisses Lane and grumbles about the lower orders' morals
Lane announces Ernest Worthing and Jack enters
Algernon and Jack trade quips about eating and country neighbours
Asked about Shropshire, Jack fumbles and asks who is coming to tea

pd_earnest_3.summary: Chasuble, Miss Prism and Cecily leave the reconciled brothers alone
Jack orders Algernon to leave and forbids any Bunburying
Merriman reports he has unpacked Mr. Ernest's abundant luggage
Jack orders the dog-cart, claiming Ernest is called back to town
Algernon calls Jack a liar and denies any duty calling him
Algernon provokes Jack about Cecily and mocks his mourning clothes
Jack bargains to change clothes if Algernon will go, trading insults
Jack denounces Algernon's vanity and goes into the house
Algernon declares his love for Cecily as she returns to water roses
Algernon and Cecily lament their painful parting

pd_sisters_1.summary: Andrey dismisses a visitor and drifts into his room
Masha confides her disappointment with her husband and civilians
Vershinin muses why Russians aim so low in life
Vershinin unburdens his miserable marriage, saying he has only Masha
Masha recalls the noise before her father's death; she is superstitious
Vershinin kisses her hand and declares his love
Masha laughs in fear, then lets him go on, covering her face
Hearing someone coming, Masha urges a change of subject
Tuzenbach and Irina enter as he vows to walk her home forever

s01107.summary: Milo climbs onto the roof and finds Sadie sitting alone
Sadie makes room and they sit watching windows as the radio plays
Milo offers a cracker and they chew together in the dark
Sadie and Milo shove each other playfully
Sadie nearly slips off the ledge and Milo grabs her sleeve
Sadie offers her hand and they climb down together
